title: A gym message to a big gym reaches members' phones only about 30 a minute, and a busy hour can drop pop-ups
what: Phone pop-ups go out one phone per call, and each one-minute run may make about 45 calls in all. The fee and payment feeds, the direct-read record and the admin-app alerts spend part of that first (the admin-app alerts alone up to 12), so about 30 phones get the pop-up each minute. A message to a gym with 500 members takes around a quarter of an hour to reach everyone. If several big gyms send at the same time, the queue can run past 6 hours, and then the server skips the rest, so those members never get the pop-up.
expected: A message to a 500-member gym reaches every phone within a minute or two, and no pop-up is dropped because the queue was long.
who: members of big gyms, and their owners
how_often: every message or offer sent to a gym with more than about 30 phones
fix_line: Send pop-ups to many phones in one call (Firebase topics or batch sending), or move the sender to a plan with more calls per run

title: Every minute, the online-payment alert reads every online payment any gym ever got
what: Once a minute, the job that tells a gym 'Asha paid online' looks for payments from the last 15 minutes. No list is sorted by the time paid, so the database goes through every paid online request of every gym, ever. Payment requests are never removed. The fee-request job does the same with every open request. Cloudflare's small database has a free limit of reads per day: with about 3,500 online payments stored, this one job alone uses the whole day's free reads (1,440 runs a day). After that, the reads either cost money or stop, along with the gym alerts.
expected: Each minute's check reads only the last few minutes of payments, however many have been stored.
who: gyms with online payments switched on, and MettleUp's running cost
how_often: every minute, getting worse with each payment
fix_line: Add a list sorted by status and time paid (and by status and time created) for these two checks, and remove old payment requests after a set time
